settings.question: Do I need a GP referral?
settings.answer: No. Our pharmacist can assess and treat you directly for every service in this category.

settings.question: Are you GPhC-registered?
settings.answer: Yes, registration 9012378. The MHRA WDA(H) wholesale dealer licence is 59619.

settings.question: How do consultations work?
settings.answer: Book online or walk in. Our pharmacist reviews your history, explains options, and delivers treatment where clinically appropriate. Aftercare is provided in writing.

settings.heading: Ready to book?
settings.subhead: Same-day appointments available. A pharmacist sees every patient.

settings.why_bullet_2: GPhC-registered pharmacy with full clinical governance.
settings.why_bullet_3: Conservative, evidence-led approach. We say no when it's right to.
settings.team_body: GPhC-registered pharmacists and trained clinicians who deliver every consultation in-house.
